title: Language Consistency Deliberation (TS vs Python)
summary: Audit of the Python layer against LangGraph.js/LangChain.js equivalents.
key_findings: Data: LangChain.js is mature, but CrewAI's specific delegation logic is superior in Python.
Geordi: Dual-runtime Docker images are a maintenance burden but provide maximum capability.
Worf: Security is improved by unifying dependencies, but Python's data processing is 'honorable'.
Quark: Total refactor ROI is negative due to high implementation cost vs. existing working logic.
conclusions: Retain Python for core Agentic Orchestration (CrewAI).
Port non-AI tools (Scrapers, File search) to TypeScript package shared by core and apps.
Maintain the MCP Bridge as the language-agnostic interface.
technical_debt_identified: setup-python.sh requires constant pinning of fast-moving AI libraries.
Dockerfile image size is currently optimized for Node, not dual-runtimes.
